output.text: This certificate recognizes outstanding patient experimentation in the development of the paper turbine. The recipient exemplified turning questions into trials, approaching each challenge with curiosity and rigor. Failed versions were documented as diligently as successful ones, reflecting a deep commitment to learning through iteration. The paper turbine stands as a symbol of perseverance, creativity, and methodical inquiry. This achievement celebrates the journey of discovery, where every attempt contributed to meaningful progress—without external prize or recognition.
